name: TypeScript Type Check on Save
description: Runs tsc --noEmit after TypeScript file changes to catch type errors immediately without waiting for build
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run TypeScript type check after file changes
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  if [[ -f "$ROOT/tsconfig.json" ]]; then
    OUTPUT=$(cd "$ROOT" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1)
    EXIT_CODE=$?
    if [[ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]]; then
      # Only show errors related to the changed file
      ERRORS=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -i "$(basename "$FILE")" | head -5)
      if [[ -n "$ERRORS" ]]; then
        echo "Type errors in $FILE:"
        echo "$ERRORS"
      fi
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
